QuestInfo.name: Ereve Investigation Permit
QuestInfo.0: So it seems that if I want to investigate Ereve in search of the Master of Disguise, I'll have to first receive an Investigation Permit. I better talk to #p1101002#.
QuestInfo.1: Neinheart has distributed all of the  Ereve Investigation Permits to other knights. You need to gather  #t4000120#s to help make more Ereve Investigation Permits.
QuestInfo.2: I gave #p1101002# some #t4005004#s, and received an Investigation Permit in return. It's now time for me to conduct a thorough search of Ereve.

0.0: ...#t4032179#? I am sorry, but there's a problem with that. Truth be told, Ereve had never faced a crisis like this before, so naturally, I have never had to provide so many copies of Investigation Permits to various Knights. Yes, I am short on supplies needed to make the Investigation Permit.
0.1: I have been quickly making new Investigation Permits, but that's also not easy in that... #t4032179# is created using an item that is placed in specifically to prevent illegal copies from being made, so... yes, I am short on one item. The search needs to start right away, as well...
0.2: Tell you what. I want you to bring me that item that is required to make the Investigation Permit. I know we don't have much time, but even the best Master of Disguise won't be able to escape Ereve that quickly, especially if the island is in code red as it is now. Once you bring me the item, I will go ahead and print you the Investigation Permit.

yes.0: #b20 #t4000120#s#k are needed to make the Investigation Permit. Permits made with the power of #t4000120#s cannot be duplicated or stolen, so it's perfect for a place like this. Thank you for your help.

no.0: Oh no.. are you giving up on the search?

yes.0: This will give you access to every part of Ereve that is currently in code red. Please search through the island carefully and find the Master of Disguise that is responsible for this mess.

item.0: I see you don't have 20 #t4000120#s yet. This is urgent, so make your way to Omega Sector quickly.

1.0: Ah, those are the #t4000120#s I needed. I'll go ahead and make you the #t4032179# you require.
